## Evidence

List actual commands, results, environment, date and artifact links for this candidate. Mark unrun or failed checks explicitly; historical results do not establish current hosted acceptance.

| Check or owner decision                        | Result  | Candidate / evidence | Remaining action |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------------------- | ---------------- |
| Local applicable verification                  | Pending |                      |                  |
| Current hosted required check                  | Pending |                      |                  |
| Independent human review                       | Pending |                      |                  |
| Security / business acceptance when applicable | Pending |                      |                  |

## Review and handoff

- [ ] Scope, contracts, negative cases and recovery implications reviewed.
- [ ] No credentials, private records, local databases or unrelated changes included.
- [ ] Changed milestone evidence and generated board synchronized; `npm run progress:check` result recorded.
- [ ] Independent reviewer identified; author self-review and agent review are not human approval.
- [ ] Any unresolved decisions, exceptions and follow-up owners recorded.

Synthetic verification does not authorize live payment, insurer issuance, coverage or deployment. Preserve `DEMO_MODE=false` rejection unless a separately approved gate change is explicitly in scope. Publication, merge and release require their applicable authorization.
